findings.title: Late Validation
findings.body:
The comment says credentials are validated "before any network calls", but the check runs only after `sandbox.commands.run('id -u && id -g')`, which is a remote sandbox call. Any setup earlier in `mountS3` that is not shown in this diff (for example, s3fs installation or checks) also runs first.

As a result, a config with a partial credential pair still makes sandbox round-trips before failing. That partly defeats the stated goal of failing fast. The check depends only on `config`, so it can move to the top of the function before any `sandbox.commands.run` calls.

findings.title: Late Validation
findings.body:
This has the same problem as the e2b version. The partial-credentials check is placed after the `id -u && id -g` sandbox command (and after any earlier setup in this function), even though the comment says it runs "before any network calls".

Since the check depends only on `config`, moving it to the start of `mountS3` would make misconfigured mounts fail immediately, as intended.
